outcome.environmentFixObservation: No 'unable to auto-detect email address' appears anywhere in this attempt, and the identity fix reached no repository here: /app/repo did not exist when the attempt started, so the harness's repo-local write had nothing to write, and the model set its own local identity (`git -C /app/repo config user.name Agent` / `user.email agent@example.com`, six calls) after creating it. That is the known boundary of the fix: it covers repositories present at setup (the common pre-cloned task shape), not repositories the model creates during the attempt.
